name: Glo Fi
paragraphs: Glow Fi is a self-animating, fractal-based glow effect for text. Add a unique, organic glow with presets and advanced controls.
Glo Fi offers a range of ready-made, animated preset schemes. Find these
via the blue Open Dashboard... button or the Choose a Preset... button below it.
As with all other Universe tools, you can modify or create a Glo Fi look and then save it under its own name by pressing the Save Preset... button.
